overview_description.description: Black Forest Labs develops advanced generative deep learning models that focus on producing and transforming visual content such as images and videos. The company offers the FLUX model suite, which includes versions designed for high-detail image creation, developer experimentation, and fast local generation. Its models use a hybrid architecture that combines diffusion and transformer techniques, allowing them to generate images from text prompts or edit existing visuals through image-to-image workflows. Black Forest Labs distributes these models through a managed API that enables product teams to embed visual generation into applications and digital platforms. The company also provides open-weight versions so developers and researchers can run, customize, or fine-tune models in their preferred environments. Its technology is adopted by creative software providers and media tools that integrate FLUX into editing, design, or content-creation pipelines. Black Forest Labs continues to expand its platform toward broader visual-intelligence infrastructure, including planned capabilities for video generation and advanced media workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: Black Forest Labs develops advanced generative deep learning models that focus on producing and transforming visual content.

product.name: FLUX.1 Model Family
product.description: A family of generative image models for producing images from text prompts, with configurable quality, speed, licensing, and deployment options.

product.name: BFL API
product.description: An API for integrating Black Forest Labs’ image-generation and image-editing models into applications, products, and enterprise workflows.

product.name: FLUX Fill
product.description: An image-editing model for masked inpainting and outpainting, allowing users to modify selected regions or extend an existing composition.

product.name: FLUX Redux
product.description: An image-variation model that transforms reference images using additional images or text prompts to create revised or substantially different compositions.

product.name: FLUX Depth
product.description: A guided image-generation model that uses depth information to control the arrangement of poses, backgrounds, objects, and other structural elements.

product.name: FLUX Canny
product.description: A guided image-generation model that uses edge or line information to preserve outlines and structural features while creating a new visual interpretation.
